headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 23, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a thrilling 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Ben Rice leading the offense. In other news, the Boston Red Sox took down the Baltimore Orioles 6-3, while the Orioles responded with a 5-1 win of their own. The Houston Astros bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Patrick Corbin being placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left teres major strain. Jonatan Clase, Samuel Basallo, J.T. Ginn, Stephen Kolek, Bobby Witt Jr., Drey Jameson, and Jack Flaherty have also been placed on the injured list with various injuries.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Astros acquiring Max Martin from the Kansas City Royals, the Los Angeles Dodgers acquiring Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies, and the Athletics trading Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 5-3 Victory Over Yankees**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought win against the New York Yankees, finishing with a final score of 5-3. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a standout performance, hitting 1 home run and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Yankees Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, securing a shutout victory. Jasson Domínguez led the Pirates' offense with a single, RBI, and three at-bats, while Max Fried pitched 5.0 strong innings for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Kyle Bradish earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Corbin Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left-handed pitcher Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left teres major strain, effective retroactive to July 22, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
